en.title: Anthropic IPO About 6x Oversubscribed, Targeting a $1.4 Trillion Valuation
en.excerpt: Anthropic's IPO has drawn roughly six times the shares on offer, targeting a $1.4 trillion valuation and a November 19 Nasdaq debut under ticker ANT, with some China and Hong Kong investors excluded.
en.content:
Anthropic's initial public offering has drawn orders for roughly **six times** the shares on offer, positioning the Claude maker for what could become the largest stock market listing in history, according to Bloomberg and Reuters.

**The numbers:** The company and existing shareholders are seeking to raise up to **$64.4 billion** by selling 825 million shares priced between $70 and $78 each. A separate private placement is expected to add about $26 billion, putting total proceeds near $90.4 billion. Shares are expected to begin trading on the Nasdaq Global Select Market on **November 19** under the ticker **ANT**, at a fully diluted valuation of about $1.4 trillion.

**Who gets in:** Bankers told prospective investors that existing backers will be prioritised, leaving some new buyers with smaller allocations. Taiwan's CTEE reported that some underwriters rejected orders from mainland Chinese and Hong Kong institutions, citing US International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR).

**The backdrop:** CEO Dario Amodei appeared with JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon in a New York roadshow, saying the company would not price itself a dollar above its real value. Goldman Sachs estimates positive annual free cash flow only by 2030, and the company has committed over $900 billion in spending through 2045. Nvidia has agreed to buy about $10 billion of shares in the placement. The listing is seen as the first real test of investor appetite for AI companies beyond chipmakers.

zh.title: Anthropic IPO 获约 6 倍超额认购，目标估值约 1.4 万亿美元
zh.excerpt: Anthropic IPO 获约 6 倍超额认购，目标估值约 1.4 万亿美元，11 月 19 日以代码 ANT 登陆纳斯达克；部分中港机构被排除在认购之外。
zh.content:
据彭博社与路透社报道，Anthropic 的首次公开发行已获得约为发行量 **6 倍** 的认购订单，这家 Claude 模型的开发商有望完成史上规模最大的股票上市。

**核心数字：** 公司与部分现有股东计划以每股 **70 至 78 美元** 发行 8.25 亿股，募资最高 **644 亿美元**；另有约 260 亿美元私募配售，合计融资接近 904 亿美元。股票预计 **11 月 19 日** 以代码 **ANT** 在纳斯达克全球精选市场挂牌，全面摊薄估值约 **1.4 万亿美元**。

**配额倾斜：** 承销商告知潜在投资者，现有投资人将获优先配售，部分新买家的配额低于预期。台湾《工商时报》报道称，部分承销行以美国《国际武器贸易条例》（ITAR）为由，拒绝接受中国大陆与香港机构的认购订单。

**市场背景：** CEO 达里奥·阿莫代伊与摩根大通 CEO 戴蒙在纽约同台路演，称公司不会把估值定在「高于实际价值一美元」。高盛估算其自由现金流要到 2030 年才转正，且到 2045 年的支出承诺累计超过 9000 亿美元；英伟达已同意在私募中认购约 100 亿美元股份。这次上市被视为市场对「卖铲子之外」的 AI 公司价值的首次真实检验。

en.title: Meituan Open-Sources LongCat-2.5: 1.6T MoE Under MIT, Trained Without Nvidia
en.excerpt: Meituan released LongCat-2.5 weights under MIT: 1.6T total parameters, about 48B active per token, a 1M-token context, and a W4A4 serving recipe on 194 Huawei Ascend chips.
en.content:
Meituan has published the weights of **LongCat-2.5**, a native multimodal mixture-of-experts model, under the MIT licence on Hugging Face, allowing commercial inference and further training without an extra grant.

**Scale:** The model has 1.6 trillion total parameters with roughly 48 billion activated per token, supports a one-million-token context and can emit up to 128,000 output tokens in one pass. The checkpoint is listed at about 1.78 trillion parameters in safetensors metadata, a gap Meituan has not explained.

**Serving on domestic silicon:** Meituan published a production recipe using **194 Huawei Ascend Atlas A2** accelerators — 2 for image tokenisation, 64 for prefill and 128 for decode — with expert weights and activations quantised to **W4A4**. Against a W8A8 baseline it reports 43.3% higher prefill throughput and 42.77% higher decode throughput at comparable accuracy.

**Benchmarks:** Meituan reports 88.4 on Terminal Bench v2.1 (versus 70.8 for LongCat-2.0) and a jump from 9.7 to 64.6 on DeepSWE — within a point of Claude Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol on the former, but roughly 10 points behind DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on the latter. Scores are marked as in-house where not externally cited.

A caution noted by analysts: the claim that the artefact never touched an Nvidia GPU is verifiable for the released model and its guide, but the training run names no chip vendor.

zh.title: 美团开源 LongCat-2.5：1.6 万亿参数 MoE，MIT 协议，全程未用英伟达 GPU
zh.excerpt: 美团以 MIT 协议开源 LongCat-2.5 权重：1.6 万亿总参数、每词元激活约 480 亿、100 万词元上下文，并给出基于 194 张华为昇腾芯片的 W4A4 部署方案。
zh.content:
美团已在 Hugging Face 以 **MIT 协议** 开源原生多模态混合专家模型 **LongCat-2.5** 的权重，允许商用推理与二次训练，无需额外授权。

**规模：** 模型总参数 1.6 万亿，每词元激活约 480 亿，支持 100 万词元上下文，单次最多输出 12.8 万词元。safetensors 元数据列出的权重约为 1.78 万亿参数，与官方口径有出入，美团尚未解释。

**国产算力部署：** 美团给出基于 **194 张华为昇腾 Atlas A2** 的生产方案——2 张做图像词元化、64 张做预填充、128 张做解码——并将专家权重与激活值量化为 **W4A4**。相比 W8A8 基线，官方称预填充吞吐提升 43.3%、解码吞吐提升 42.77%，精度相当。

**跑分：** 美团自报 Terminal Bench v2.1 达 88.4（上代为 70.8），DeepSWE 从 9.7 跃升至 64.6；前者与 Claude Opus 5、GPT-5.6 Sol 相差不到 1 分，后者仍落后 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 约 10 分。未标注外部来源的成绩均为厂商自测。

分析者提醒：「从未使用英伟达 GPU」这一说法对发布物与部署指南成立，但训练过程未披露芯片厂商，无法核验。

en.title: Baidu Cuts Video Generation to 0.2 Yuan Per Second, Launches Short-Drama Studio
en.excerpt: At Baidu World 2026, Baidu's Yijing unveiled a self-developed video model costing 0.2 yuan per second, AU-level micro-expression control and a one-stop short-drama studio.
en.content:
At Baidu World 2026 on November 12, Baidu's digital-human product Yijing (一镜) announced a self-developed video generation model and three capability upgrades.

**Cost:** By combining hybrid diffusion distillation with sparse modelling, generation cost falls to **0.2 yuan per second**. The Fast version generates at a 1:1 ratio — a 10-second clip in 10 seconds.

**Expression:** The Wenxin Yijing micro-expression model uses a quality agent and more than 200 sub-dimensions to deliver AU-level facial control, producing up to **8–9 micro-expressions per second**, aimed at removing the stiff AI face.

**Interaction:** Real-time interaction moves beyond local motion to full-frame streaming output with sub-2-second latency, supported by an autoregressive architecture and retrieval-based memory.

**Short-Drama Studio:** A script agent and a film agent cover the full pipeline from idea or novel IP to finished short drama, with one-click localisation and redrawing for overseas markets. Baidu cites internal figures of a 34.9% shorter delivery cycle and, for e-commerce exports, an 83% cost reduction with a 29% conversion lift.

The claims are Baidu's own; the launch was covered by Xinhua, the China Youth Daily tech channel and China Economic Net.

zh.title: 百度一镜将视频生成降至每秒 0.2 元，推出短漫剧 Studio
zh.excerpt: 在 2026 百度世界大会上，百度一镜发布自研视频生成模型，成本低至每秒 0.2 元，实现 AU 级微表情控制，并推出一站式短漫剧 Studio。
zh.content:
11 月 12 日，在 2026 百度世界大会上，百度数字人产品「一镜」发布视频生成自研模型，并宣布三大核心能力升级。

**成本：** 通过混合扩散蒸馏与稀疏化建模，视频生成成本下探至 **每秒 0.2 元**；Fast 版实现 1:1 极速生成，10 秒视频 10 秒产出。

**表情：** 文心一镜微表情大模型结合质量 Agent 与 200 多个子维度，实现 AU 级面部控制，每秒最多呈现 **8–9 种微表情**，目标是消除僵硬的「AI 脸」。

**交互：** 实时互动从局部动作升级为全画幅流式输出，响应时延低于 2 秒，由自回归架构与检索式记忆支撑无限时长互动。

**短漫剧 Studio：** 剧本 Agent 与成片 Agent 协同，打通从灵感或百万字小说 IP 到成片的全流程，支持一键本土化与转绘，降低短剧出海门槛。百度自报内部数据显示需求交付周期缩短 34.9%；电商出海方案成本下降 83%、转化率提升 29%。

上述数据均为百度自报，发布会由新华网、中国青年网科技频道与中国经济网等报道。

en.title: Runway Open-Sources Praxis-1, a 27B World Action Model for Robots
en.excerpt: Runway released Praxis-1 weights and code under Apache 2.0: a 27B video-pretrained model that predicts scene changes and robot actions together, scoring 46.2% on RoboLab-120.
en.content:
Runway, best known for AI video generation, has released the weights and source code of **Praxis-1** under the Apache 2.0 licence, permitting commercial use. It is the first time the company has opened its video-model capabilities for robot control.

**How it works:** Praxis-1 takes camera frames, a text instruction and robot joint state, predicts how the scene will change and computes the actions that would produce it. Runway calls this a World Action Model. Training starts from general video, then adds human-motion video and robot data — a route intended to reduce dependence on expensive robot-specific datasets.

**Architecture:** A 26.9B-parameter video diffusion backbone (about 2.8B active per token) is paired with a 314M-parameter, 16-layer action expert that reads hidden states from eight encoder blocks via cross-attention. Checkpoints include a base model plus DROID single-arm and YAM dual-arm fine-tunes; nvfp4 quantization brings the footprint to 17.5 GB.

**Results:** On Nvidia's RoboLab-120 benchmark, Praxis-1 succeeded in **46.2%** of 1,200 episodes, ahead of FLUX 3 Action (42.9%) and Cosmos3 Nano (36.8%). On a real Franka arm it succeeded 88 of 100 attempts versus 80 for FLUX 3 Action. Runway ran all tests itself; none has been independently verified. Adapting it to a new arm still needs roughly 277 hours of DROID data.

Sources: Runway's research post, The Robot Report and The Decoder (November 14–15).

zh.title: Runway 开源 Praxis-1：270 亿参数世界动作模型，同时预测视频与机器人动作
zh.excerpt: Runway 以 Apache 2.0 开源 Praxis-1 权重与代码：这个 270 亿参数的视频预训练模型同时预测场景变化与机器人动作，在 RoboLab-120 得 46.2%。
zh.content:
以 AI 视频生成著称的 Runway 已按 **Apache 2.0 协议** 开源 **Praxis-1** 的权重与源代码，允许商用。这是该公司首次将其视频模型能力开放给机器人控制。

**工作原理：** Praxis-1 接收摄像头画面、文本指令与机器人关节状态，先预测场景如何变化，再计算实现该变化的动作。Runway 称之为「世界动作模型」。训练从通用视频起步，再加入人类动作视频与机器人数据，以减少对昂贵机器人专用数据集的依赖。

**架构：** 269 亿参数的视频扩散骨干（每词元激活约 28 亿）配一个 3.14 亿参数、16 层的动作专家，通过交叉注意力读取骨干八个编码器块的隐状态。发布的检查点包括基座版及 DROID 单臂、YAM 双臂微调版；NVFP4 量化将体积压至 17.5 GB。

**成绩：** 在英伟达 RoboLab-120 基准的 1200 个回合中成功率 **46.2%**，高于 FLUX 3 Action 的 42.9% 与 Cosmos3 Nano 的 36.8%；在真实 Franka 机械臂上 100 次尝试成功 88 次，对照为 80 次。所有测试均由 Runway 自测，尚无独立复现；迁移到新机械臂仍需约 277 小时 DROID 数据。

来源：Runway 研究博客、The Robot Report 与 The Decoder（11 月 14–15 日）。

en.title: United Airlines Bars Unauthorised Third-Party AI Agents from Booking Tickets
en.excerpt: United revised its contract of carriage on November 11 to bar third-party AI agents from making or servicing bookings, even under passenger supervision, citing security and federal rules.
en.content:
United Airlines has moved to restrict access by what it calls unauthorised third-party personal AI agents or assistants, both on its own digital platforms and indirectly through travel agencies and aggregators.

**What changed:** A revised contract of carriage dated November 11 defines AI agents broadly — including tools acting under a passenger's supervision — and bars them from making, modifying or servicing tickets. United may cancel affected reservations; other listed remedies include invalidating tickets, removing MileagePlus miles and ending membership. AI tools may still search flights and show fares, but a person must complete the purchase.

**Why:** United cites credential sharing that can expose sensitive data, unintended purchases or mileage use, and possible conflict with US Department of Transportation and Federal Aviation Administration rules — for example, the requirement that a traveller personally confirm baggage contains no prohibited items.

**The commercial edge:** CEO Scott Kirby told the Wall Street Journal he does not want to create another middleman. Southwest and Expedia are working with ChatGPT, while Amazon and JPMorgan Chase have restricted outside agents. Uber disclosed that in one week with about 320 million trips and orders, agents booked just four rides.

**Caveats:** United has given no effective date and has not said how it will detect agents or whether an approved-agent route will exist. The policy was reported by CNBC, Skift, CBS News and the Wall Street Journal.

zh.title: 美联航禁止未经授权的第三方 AI 代理代订机票
zh.excerpt: 美联航 11 月 11 日修订运输合同，禁止第三方 AI 代理代订或改签机票——即便旅客全程监督也不行，理由涉及账户安全与联邦规定。
zh.content:
美联航已着手限制其所谓的「未经授权的第三方个人 AI 代理或助手」访问服务，既包括自有数字平台，也包括通过旅行社与聚合平台的间接访问。

**改了什么：** 11 月 11 日修订的运输合同对 AI 代理做了宽泛定义——包含在旅客监督下行动的工具——禁止其代订、改签或处理机票。美联航可取消相关预订；其他列出的救济措施包括作废机票、扣除常旅客里程和终止会员资格。AI 工具仍可搜索航班与显示票价，但购买须由本人完成。

**理由：** 美联航提到共享登录凭据可能暴露敏感信息、导致非预期购票或里程使用，以及可能与美国运输部和联邦航空管理局规定冲突，例如旅客须亲自确认行李不含违禁品。

**商业动机：** CEO 斯科特·柯比对《华尔街日报》表示，他不想再创造「另一个中间商」。西南航空与 Expedia 正与 ChatGPT 合作，亚马逊和摩根大通则限制外部代理。Uber 披露，在约 3.2 亿单服务的一周里，AI 代理只订了 4 次叫车。

**待解问题：** 美联航未给出生效日期，也未说明如何识别代理、是否会开放「授权代理」通道。该政策由 CNBC、Skift、CBS News 与《华尔街日报》报道。

en.title: Anthropic Circulates Draft AI Safety Bill Letting Courts Block Risky Models
en.excerpt: Anthropic's draft bill would let a court block a model only when imminent risk could kill or injure more than 50 people or cause over $1 billion in damage, with evaluations by Commerce-registered assessors.
en.content:
Anthropic has confirmed it is circulating a draft AI safety bill among US lawmakers, filling a vacuum left by Congress, which has passed no major technology law since 1998.

**The threshold:** Washington could block a model's release or use only if there is an imminent risk of killing or seriously injuring more than **50 people**, or causing more than **$1 billion** in damage. Politico reports the risk must arise from the creation or release of a biological weapon, the model bypassing its safeguards, or a cyberattack — thresholds that mirror California's Senate Bill 53.

**The mechanism:** Disaster potential would be assessed by independent evaluators registered with the Commerce Department. Labs could fund them, provided payment is not tied to evaluation outcomes — a safeguard whose effectiveness is unclear. If imminent catastrophic risk is found, evaluators must notify the department within 72 hours; the department would then petition a D.C. judge for an injunction. No federal agency could halt distribution unilaterally. The bill would also override certain state laws.

**Reaction:** A company spokesperson said the proposal grants government the ability to block dangerous deployments while requiring frontier developers to test powerful models, publish findings, undergo independent evaluation and maintain security programmes. Charlie Bullock of the Institute for Law & AI called it pretty reasonable but weaker than the FRONTIER Act. a16z's Martin Casado called it actually quite reasonable — a notable shift for a generally anti-regulation investor.

Sources: Politico, AFP, TechCrunch and follow-up coverage.

zh.title: Anthropic 向美国国会提交 AI 安全法案草案，法官可阻断危险模型
zh.excerpt: Anthropic 法案草案设三重门槛：风险须可预见且迫近、可能造成 50 人以上伤亡或逾 10 亿美元损失、源自生物武器或模型失控或网络攻击，方可由法官下令阻断。
zh.content:
Anthropic 已确认正在向美国议员传阅一份 AI 安全法案草案，填补国会自 1998 年以来未通过重大科技立法所留下的空白。

**门槛：** 只有在存在迫近风险、可能造成 **50 人以上死亡或重伤**，或 **超过 10 亿美元损失** 时，政府才能阻断模型的发布或使用。据 Politico 报道，风险还须源自生物武器的制造或释放、模型绕过自身安全措施、或网络攻击——这些门槛与加州 SB 53 法案一致。

**机制：** 模型的灾难潜能由在商务部注册的独立评估员评定。实验室可以出资，但付款不得与评估结果挂钩——这一防火墙的有效性尚不明确。若发现迫近的灾难性风险，评估员须在 72 小时内通知商务部，由其向华盛顿特区法官申请禁令；任何联邦机构不得单方面叫停模型分发。法案还将优先于部分州法。

**反响：** 公司发言人称，提案赋予政府阻断危险部署的能力，同时要求前沿开发者测试强大模型、公开结果、接受独立评估并维持安全计划。法律与 AI 研究所的查理·布洛克称其「相当合理」但弱于 FRONTIER 法案；一向反监管的 a16z 合伙人马丁·卡萨多也评价「确实相当合理」。

来源：Politico、法新社、TechCrunch 及后续报道。

en.title: Anthropic Buys a One-Person Biotech as Big Tech Pours Into AI Drug Discovery
en.excerpt: Anthropic acquired Mithril Medicine, a one-employee biotech using Claude to coordinate 11 external labs, with a rare-disease candidate possibly entering human trials by late 2028.
en.content:
Anthropic has acquired **Mithril Medicine**, a Cambridge, Massachusetts biotech with a single full-time employee — founder Cody Tranbarger, who announced the deal on X with two surprises: that Anthropic had bought a one-person biotech, and that he was that person.

**What it does:** Founded in late 2024, Mithril is developing treatments for two rare forms of muscular dystrophy — LAMA2-related congenital muscular dystrophy and alpha-dystroglycanopathy. Tranbarger used Claude to contract, coordinate and track **11 external laboratories**; one candidate moved from idea to mouse studies in under 18 months. Anthropic said a drug could reach human trials as early as **late 2028** if candidates hold up. The price was not disclosed. Anthropic disclosed the acquisition in an October 27 post; a November 15–16 cover story in China Newsweek renewed attention.

**The wider wave:** Nvidia and Eli Lilly plan to invest up to $1 billion together over five years in a joint lab. ByteDance spun out its five-year-old AI drug team as Anew Labs in June, reportedly raising $290 million. OpenAI has released a life-sciences model, still positioned as a tool for researchers. Isomorphic Labs is in talks to raise at a valuation of at least $40 billion, according to Bloomberg.

**The catch:** Compute can compress molecule discovery, but the clinical-trial timeline — the time wall — remains. Stanford computer scientist Jie Zou notes AI enables small-team pipelines; Third Rock Ventures' Jeb Keiper stresses that drug development still needs an industry collective.

zh.title: Anthropic 收购「一人药企」，科技巨头集体涌入 AI 制药
zh.excerpt: Anthropic 收购仅一名员工的 Mithril Medicine：这家公司用 Claude 协调 11 家外部实验室，罕见病候选药最快 2028 年底进入人体试验。
zh.content:
Anthropic 已收购 **Mithril Medicine**——一家位于马萨诸塞州剑桥、只有一名全职员工的生物科技公司。创始人科迪·特兰巴格在 X 上用「两个惊喜」宣布交易：Anthropic 买下了一家一人生物科技公司，而这个人就是他自己。

**做什么：** Mithril 创立于 2024 年底，研发两种罕见肌营养不良症的疗法——LAMA2 相关先天性肌营养不良症与 α-肌营养不良蛋白病。特兰巴格借助 Claude 与 **11 家外部实验室** 签约、跟进物流并协调实验；其中一种潜在疗法不到 18 个月就从构想推进到小鼠实验。Anthropic 称，若候选药顺利，最快 **2028 年底** 进入人体试验。收购金额未披露。Anthropic 在 10 月 27 日的文章中披露此事，《中国新闻周刊》11 月 15–16 日封面报道令其再度受到关注。

**更大的浪潮：** 英伟达与礼来计划五年内合计投入最多 10 亿美元共建联合实验室；字节跳动 6 月将孵化五年的 AI 制药团队拆分为新生实验室（Anew Labs），据报首轮融资 2.9 亿美元；OpenAI 推出面向生命科学的模型，但仍定位为研究者的工具；据彭博社，谷歌系同构实验室正以至少 400 亿美元估值洽谈融资。

**瓶颈：** 算力可以压缩候选分子的发现，但临床试验的「时间墙」依然存在。斯坦福大学计算机科学家邹杰认为 AI 会催生小团队研发模式；Third Rock Ventures 合伙人杰布·凯珀则提醒，一款药物的诞生仍需行业共同体协作。

en.title: Microsoft Confirms Global Outlook, Teams and Copilot Outage Was Not a Cyberattack
en.excerpt: A capacity upgrade triggered a two-day outage across Outlook, Teams, Copilot and Microsoft 365, with Downdetector reports topping 130,000; US lawmakers have asked Microsoft for information.
en.content:
Microsoft has apologised for a large-scale outage that spread from Thursday into Friday, disrupting Outlook email, Teams collaboration, Copilot and other Microsoft 365 services worldwide.

**Scale:** Outage tracker Downdetector recorded more than **130,000** reports of Outlook problems at peak. Microsoft 365 email backlogs approached normal levels after the fix, but the company did not immediately give a full recovery timetable.

**Cause:** Microsoft said the failure originated in an earlier network capacity upgrade, that the root cause has been resolved, and that it was **not** related to a cyberattack or to AI agents — a point of some sensitivity given recent incidents of autonomous agents misbehaving.

**Aftermath:** US lawmakers have requested information from Microsoft about the disruption. The episode arrives in a week already dominated by AI infrastructure stress: CoreWeave's earnings, a $28 billion Anthropic data-centre lease and Nvidia's leadership transition. It underscores that even the largest cloud operators remain vulnerable to change-management failures in the network layer.

zh.title: 微软确认 Outlook、Teams 与 Copilot 全球中断并非网络攻击所致
zh.excerpt: 一次网络容量升级引发 Outlook、Teams、Copilot 与 Microsoft 365 持续两天的全球中断，Downdetector 报告峰值超 13 万条；美国议员已向微软索要信息。
zh.content:
微软已就一场从周四蔓延至周五的大规模中断道歉。故障波及全球 Outlook 邮件、Teams 协作、Copilot 及其他 Microsoft 365 服务。

**规模：** 故障监测平台 Downdetector 记录到 Outlook 问题报告在峰值时超过 **13 万条**。修复后邮件积压已接近正常，但微软未立即给出全面恢复时间表。

**原因：** 微软称故障源于此前一次网络容量升级，根本原因已解决，且与网络攻击或 AI 智能体 **无关**——鉴于近期多起自主智能体失控事件，这一点格外敏感。

**后续：** 美国议员已就宕机事件向微软索要信息。这起事件发生在本周 AI 基础设施压力事件密集之际：CoreWeave 财报、Anthropic 的 280 亿美元数据中心租约、英伟达领导层变动。它提醒人们，即便是最大的云运营商，仍会因网络层的变更管理失误而瘫痪。

en.title: Study: Generating Non-English Text Can Use Up to 180 Times More Energy
en.excerpt: University of Michigan's Language-Energy Divide, presented at EMNLP 2026, found Hindi uses 7.9x and Bengali 15.3x the energy of English across Qwen 3, Gemma 3 and Llama 3.1, with lower accuracy too.
en.content:
Generative AI uses far more energy to produce non-English text than equivalent English — between **1.4 and 180 times** more — according to The Language-Energy Divide, a University of Michigan study presented at EMNLP 2026.

**Method:** Researchers measured Qwen 3, Gemma 3 and Llama 3.1 answering reading-comprehension questions from the Belebele dataset in 122 languages, using the university's ML.Energy framework on its Great Lakes cluster. Lead author is PhD student Naihao Deng; corresponding author is U-M AI Lab director Rada Mihalcea.

**Findings:** Hindi, spoken by hundreds of millions, costs **7.9 times** the energy of equivalent English; Bengali costs **15.3 times**. Most Western European languages cost up to twice as much. The team estimates about **5.2 billion people** need more than twice the energy to generate text in their first language. There is a double penalty: higher-energy languages also tend to get less accurate answers.

**Why:** Tokenisation. Scripts such as Devanagari and Bengali shatter into far more tokens; more tokens fill memory, force smaller batches and raise energy per token — and per-token pricing passes the cost to users. An independent replication on dev.to (November 14) counted 278 Bengali tokens versus 44 English on Llama 3.1's tokenizer for the same paragraph, but only 51 versus 44 on Gemma 3, whose 262,000-token vocabulary covers Indic scripts.

**Recommendations:** Route queries to language-specific models, or translate prompts into English first where translation is reliable. The work was partly funded by NSF, DARPA, Ford, OpenAI and others.

zh.title: 研究：生成非英语文本的耗能最高可达英语的 180 倍
zh.excerpt: 密歇根大学在 EMNLP 2026 发表《语言—能源鸿沟》：在 Qwen 3、Gemma 3 与 Llama 3.1 上，印地语耗能为英语的 7.9 倍、孟加拉语 15.3 倍，且准确率更低。
zh.content:
据密歇根大学在 EMNLP 2026 发表的《语言—能源鸿沟》研究，生成非英语文本所需能量是同等英语文本的 **1.4 至 180 倍**。

**方法：** 研究者用该校自研的 ML.Energy 框架，在 Great Lakes 集群上测量 Qwen 3、Gemma 3 与 Llama 3.1 回答 Belebele 阅读理解数据集 122 种语言问题时的能耗。第一作者为博士生邓奈豪，通讯作者为密歇根大学 AI 实验室主任拉达·米哈伊尔恰。

**发现：** 数亿人使用的印地语耗能为同等英语的 **7.9 倍**，孟加拉语为 **15.3 倍**；多数西欧语言不超过英语的两倍。团队估计约 **52 亿人** 用母语生成文本需付出两倍以上的能量。更糟的是存在「双重惩罚」：耗能越高的语言，答案准确率往往也越低。

**原因：** 分词。天城文与孟加拉文等文字被切成远更多的词元；词元增多会占满内存、迫使批次变小，抬高每词元能耗——而按词元计费又把成本转嫁给用户。dev.to 上 11 月 14 日的一项独立复现发现，同一段话在 Llama 3.1 分词器下孟加拉语需 278 个词元、英语仅 44 个；但在拥有 26.2 万词表、覆盖印度文字的 Gemma 3 上，仅为 51 比 44。

**建议：** 将查询路由到特定语言模型，或在翻译可靠时先把提示译成英语。研究部分由 NSF、DARPA、福特与 OpenAI 等资助。

en.title: Liquid AI Ships LFM2.5-1.2B Thinking: Reasoning in About 900 MB On Device
en.excerpt: Liquid AI released an on-device 1.2B reasoning model with a 128K context that runs in roughly 900 MB, using internal thinking traces before answering, with data staying on the phone.
en.content:
Liquid AI has released **LFM2.5-1.2B Thinking**, an inference model designed to run entirely on-device — about **900 MB** of memory is enough for a regular smartphone.

**How it reasons:** Rather than answering directly, the model generates an internal thinking trajectory first — a System-2-like slow-thinking step that it says improves logical consistency and self-correction. It targets tool use, mathematics and complex instruction following.

**Architecture:** The model has 1.2 billion parameters across 16 hybrid layers, only six of which keep a growing attention cache; the rest use short convolutions. Context reaches 128,000 tokens, vocabulary is 65,536, and eight languages are supported. Quantised builds are small: a 4-bit MLX version is about 628 MB and an 8-bit version about 1.16 GB, versus roughly 2.34 GB for BF16.

**Implications:** No cloud round-trip means no privacy exposure from uploads and full offline operation. The LFM Open licence carries a revenue threshold that deployers must check; public benchmarks for the Thinking variant remain limited, so expectations should be calibrated.

Sources: Liquid AI and HM.AI, Hugging Face model cards and quantisation trackers, November 14–15.

zh.title: Liquid AI 发布 LFM2.5-1.2B Thinking：约 900MB 即可在端侧完成推理
zh.excerpt: Liquid AI 发布端侧 12 亿参数推理模型，支持 12.8 万词元上下文、约 900MB 内存运行，先生成内部思考轨迹再作答，数据不出设备。
zh.content:
Liquid AI 已发布 **LFM2.5-1.2B Thinking**——一款专为纯端侧运行设计的推理模型，约 **900MB** 内存即可在普通手机上流畅运行。

**如何思考：** 模型不直接作答，而是先生成内部思考轨迹——类似「系统 2」的慢思考步骤，官方称可提升逻辑一致性与自我纠错能力，重点面向工具调用、数学计算与复杂指令遵循。

**架构：** 12 亿参数、16 层混合结构，其中仅 6 层保留随上下文增长的注意力缓存，其余使用短卷积；上下文达 12.8 万词元，词表 6.55 万，支持 8 种语言。量化版体积很小：4bit MLX 版约 628MB、8bit 版约 1.16GB，而 BF16 原版约 2.34GB。

**意义：** 无需云端往返，意味着上传环节没有隐私暴露，并可完全离线工作。需注意 LFM Open 许可设有营收门槛，部署前应核对条款；Thinking 版的公开基准仍有限，预期应留有余地。

来源：Liquid AI / HM.AI、Hugging Face 模型卡与量化追踪站，11 月 14–15 日。

en.title: OpenAI Disbands Dedicated Robotics Team, Betting on General Models to Control Robots
en.excerpt: OpenAI has folded its robotics researchers into core research, saying general models such as GPT-6 Astra can control robots directly; it says robotics remains a long-term core goal.
en.content:
OpenAI has disbanded its dedicated robotics team, folding researchers into its core research and applied divisions, in a reorganisation it says is meant to accelerate general-purpose robotics rather than signal an exit.

**The reasoning:** The company believes frontier general models such as GPT-6 Astra can control robots directly, reducing the case for a separate robotics track. In an Nvidia study cited in coverage, an Astra-powered agent reached a **74.8%** success rate on simulated robot tasks versus 51% for the best specialised models — in simulation only.

**Reaction:** Early reports described the team as disbanded; OpenAI subsequently clarified that robotics work continues and remains a long-term core vision. Observers are re-evaluating the pace of physical AI given the absence of a dedicated unit.

**Context:** The move runs opposite to the week's other robotics news — Runway open-sourcing its Praxis-1 world action model and Baidu's embodied world-model release — highlighting two competing routes to embodiment: general foundation models versus purpose-built world and action models.

Sources: Wall Street CN Breakfast (November 16), Machine Intelligence and Rebabel, my2cents.ai summary, November 15.

zh.title: OpenAI 解散独立机器人团队，押注通用模型直接控制机器人
zh.excerpt: OpenAI 将机器人研究人员并入核心研究部门，理由是 GPT-6 Astra 等通用模型已能直接控制机器人；公司强调机器人仍是长期核心愿景。
zh.content:
OpenAI 已解散其专属机器人团队，将研究人员并入核心研究与应用部门。公司称这次重组是为了加快通用机器人研发，而非退出该领域。

**理由：** OpenAI 认为 GPT-6 Astra 等前沿通用模型已能直接控制机器人，因此单独设立机器人团队的意义下降。报道援引英伟达一项研究称，由 Astra 驱动的智能体在模拟机器人任务上成功率达 **74.8%**，而最佳专用模型为 51%——但该结果仅限仿真环境。

**反响：** 早期报道将此举描述为「解散团队」；OpenAI 随后澄清机器人工作仍在继续，且仍是长期核心愿景。鉴于不再有独立部门，业界正重新评估「物理 AI」的推进节奏。

**背景：** 这一动作与本周其他机器人新闻方向相反——Runway 开源 Praxis-1 世界动作模型、百度发布具身世界模型——凸显出具身智能的两条竞争路线：一条依托通用基础模型，另一条依赖专门构建的世界／动作模型。

来源：华尔街见闻早餐（11 月 16 日）、机器之心／Rebabel、my2cents.ai 摘要（11 月 15 日）。
